ebea2cf5-ce6c-4586-b2ad-a414fc7e0d22.title: Mushoku no Eiyuu: Betsu ni Skill Nanka Iranakatta nda ga—Sainou Zero no Nariagari
ebea2cf5-ce6c-4586-b2ad-a414fc7e0d22.altTitle: It's Okay., The Hero Who Has No Class.
ebea2cf5-ce6c-4586-b2ad-a414fc7e0d22.description: "Classes" are given at the age of 10, and the presence or absence of "skills" greatly affect life. Arel, the son of "Sword Princess" Fara and "Magic King" Leon, has been branded as "Classless"... But even without a job or skills, Arel believes he can persevere through effort.

7f15e45c-b7fd-4164-8d8e-ede14a817f0d.title: Academy eseo Saranamgi
7f15e45c-b7fd-4164-8d8e-ede14a817f0d.description: Kehidupanku berubah saat menjadi tokoh antagonis ekstra game favoritku. Padahal aku hanya ingin hidup santai tanpa ambisi, tapi sulit sekali bertahan di dunia ini. Pokoknya aku harus bertahan hidup dengan cara yang tak terbayangkan oleh para pemeran utama!

78f74425-e2ce-4b6a-8056-2878a712be95.title: Academy Orangkaega Ipakaetda
78f74425-e2ce-4b6a-8056-2878a712be95.description:
I found myself possessed in a game I used to play occasionally.
And to top it off, I'm the female warrior of a barbarian tribe that only has bad endings.

...Alright, let's escape.

de491df4-153f-44e8-96d2-7c53d11c3dcf.title: Hellper 2 <KillBeros>
de491df4-153f-44e8-96d2-7c53d11c3dcf.description: Indeed it is, indeed it does. A street action comic featuring the life of Jang Gwangnam leading up to the creation of the Killberos Tribe.

ecad68c0-aa99-4148-89ec-07752de7834e.title: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life o Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" o Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka o Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
ecad68c0-aa99-4148-89ec-07752de7834e.altTitle: The Exiled Cheating Magician Enjoys a Carefree Second Life.: I Can Grant “Reinforcement Points” Not Only to Weapons, but to Anything, and I Can Revoke the Effects at Any Time I Choose. But Are Those Left Behind Okay?
ecad68c0-aa99-4148-89ec-07752de7834e.description: Rein the Enchanter is a support mage with the ability to enhance weapons and armor. But when he gets fired from his guild for the simple reason that he's already enchanted everything they own, he decides to take the power back into his own hands—literally! Rein recalls every enchantment he ever put on his guildmates' gear, retrieving the bonus points for himself. But does he really not have anything better to enchant with them than some Plain Clothes and a Copper Sword…? Come along on a cheat-tier journey from the most common of common origins!

7215b1e8-bac1-49a2-83d9-ed62335dd849.title: Kekkon shiyou. Rikon zentei de.
7215b1e8-bac1-49a2-83d9-ed62335dd849.altTitle: Please Marry Me with Divorce in Mind
7215b1e8-bac1-49a2-83d9-ed62335dd849.description:
After turning 30 as a NEET, Kyousuke was kicked out of his parents' house. 
That's when Rui, his closest friend, proposes a solution: to get married, then divorce!


A guy and girl who've been 'just friends' for around a decade decide to enter a pretend marriage.
He's a romantic and she's just a pragmatic girl.  A pair unsuited for marriage.
What will they discover after 100 days together?

cb11f862-2877-4adc-ac5a-0719da9b6122.title: Nae ga Jeojuhaneun Yeongung
cb11f862-2877-4adc-ac5a-0719da9b6122.description: 'When I was about to give up, my first love came back to me after 10 years.' Si-woon, who had left the neighborhood 10 years ago and whom I thought I would never see again, suddenly came to see Harim. And he had become the best hero in the country! Seeing Si-woon's appearance that seemed to have changed but didn't, Harim realized the feelings that she had thought had disappeared long ago, and she began to feel differently about her boring life. However, just a few days later, she learned a shocking truth...

ed015c06-2293-42b5-8bb7-51df1bf95a2c.title: Phantom Movie Star
ed015c06-2293-42b5-8bb7-51df1bf95a2c.description:
In "Screen City", actors can go inside the world of a movie firsthand. One day, well-known A-list Screen City actor Nam Woo-Joo is in the midst of a performance when an intruder by the name of Woo Joo-Yeon repeatedly kills him one movie after the other, subsequently pushing Nam Woo-Joo out of his limelight as the star. Nam Woo-Joo, who can't help but grow spiteful, finally begins to face off against Woo Joo-Yeon, the movie terrorist, but...

"Just what is the reason you're doing this to me, Woo Joo-Yeon...?!"

fe9b4485-550a-4823-84eb-8680283b5d9f.title: Yuuenchi – Baki Gaiden
fe9b4485-550a-4823-84eb-8680283b5d9f.description: The story follows a dark place inside the world of the Baki series, the so-called "Amusement Park." The main character is Mumon Katsuragi, older brother of Katsumi. He ventures into a dark place where money is everything and lives are cheap, the "Amusement Park," motivated to find the killer of his mentor and master Taizan Matsumoto. The killer left a few trails behind and with his wits and physical prowess, he's been able to track him down to the ultimate dangerous fighting arena.
